content: Phase 1: Create branch feat/nextjs-fullstack + backup old code
Phase 1: Bootstrap Next.js 15 in /app/web (TS + Tailwind + shadcn/ui)
Phase 1: Prisma db pull from MariaDB (18 tables) + generate client + lib/db.ts
Phase 1: Core libs - storage.ts (R2+sharp+fallback), auth.ts (bcryptjs+jose), tz.ts
Phase 1: Preview bridge - FastAPI proxy 8001→3000, frontend supervisor redirect to next dev
Phase 1: POC landing page - / (SSG/ISR) rendering gallery from DB
Phase 1: Run test-core.ts and verify all POC user stories pass
Phase 2A: Port shadcn/ui components + Tailwind + fonts from legacy frontend
Phase 2B: Port all API Route Handlers 1:1 with FastAPI (auth, users, catalog, sales, orders, purchases, customers, finance, dashboard, reports, settings, admin, export, gallery, upload, health)
Phase 2C: Port landing pages (/, /galeri, /gallery, /price-list, /price-list-print-only, /order) + SSG/SEO/sitemap/robots + i18n
Phase 2D: Port POS pages (/login, /pos, /app/*) + Layout guard + all menus
Phase 2E: Port Gallery Manager + upload WebP UI
Phase 2F: Port Mongo→MariaDB migration to lib/migration/mongo.ts + /app/migrasi UI
Phase 2G: Seed idempotent + Zod validation + role guards
Phase 2H: End-to-end test via testing_agent_v3 + fix all bugs
Phase 3: Root Dockerfile standalone + update DEPLOY.md
Phase 3: Commit to feat/nextjs-fullstack + PR to main
